document_findings.label: County building routing
document_findings.text: The retained form routes sign building permits to Hamilton County Buildings & Inspections. This does not identify a separate electrical issuer or inspector.
document_findings.matched_text: Signs also require a building permit

document_findings.label: Submission package
document_findings.text: The form requests four or six drawing sets based on county requirements plus one Township set, site/elevation plans, sign dimensions and illumination, existing-sign photos/dimensions and photometric drawings for lit signs. Confirm current paper/digital acceptance.

document_findings.label: Printed fee candidates
document_findings.text: The April 2021 form prints new-sign and face-change fee formulas and a doubled-fee checkbox. These remain historical printed candidates; current fees are not approved.

document_findings.label: Document identity anomaly
document_findings.text: Physical page 4 names Monroe County, Indiana above its table list, while the retained document is published as Delhi zoning. Preserve the original and verify publisher correction/current compilation before approval.

document_findings.label: Permit and electrical-code applicability
document_findings.text: Article 17 describes zoning certificates, sign-panel changes and compliance with the applicable electrical code for illuminated signs. No code edition or electrical office is established here.

document_findings.label: Conditional zoning exemptions
document_findings.text: Signs exempt from zoning certificates must still comply with applicable height, area and location standards. This does not establish building or electrical exemptions.

document_findings.label: District and sign-type table
document_findings.text: Article 17 includes a district/sign-type summary table. Preserve its original layout and linked provisions; no numeric or district allowance is approved for a job.

document_findings.label: Temporary-sign standards
document_findings.text: Temporary signs have separate standards in Section 17.9; permit exemption alone does not remove size, placement or duration review.
